plant.title: The Mystery Plant
plant.question: Adjust the light and water and see what happens to the plant!

0-0.text: With no light and no water, the plant wilts and dies quickly.

0-1.text: Without light, the plant grows weak and yellow even with enough water.

0-2.text: Too much water without light drowns the roots and the plant doesn't survive.

1-0.text: There is light, but without water the plant dries out and wilts.

1-1.text: Balanced light and water! The plant grows healthy and green.

1-2.text: Normal light but too much water rots the roots.

2-0.text: A lot of light without water dries the plant out fast.

2-1.text: Lots of light and normal water — the plant grows strong and blooms!

2-2.text: Lots of light and lots of water keep the plant lush, but be careful not to overwater it.

gravity.title: Jumping in Space
gravity.question: Pick a planet and see how gravity changes your jump!

planets.label: Moon
planets.text: On the Moon gravity is much weaker. You would jump about 6 times higher!

planets.label: Earth
planets.text: On Earth this is your normal jump.

planets.label: Jupiter
planets.text: On Jupiter gravity is much stronger. Your jump would be much lower!

water.title: The Three States of Water
water.question: Move the temperature and watch water change state!

0.text: The water freezes and turns solid: ice!

1.text: At room temperature water is liquid.

2.text: The water boils and turns into steam: a gas!

electric.title: Electric Lab
electric.question: Choose what connects the battery to the bulb and find out if it lights up!
electric.middleLabel: What connects the battery to the bulb?

wire.text: The circuit is complete! Electric current flows from the battery, through the wire, lights the bulb, and returns to the battery.

broken.text: The wire is broken — there is a gap in the middle. Electric current cannot cross that gap, so the bulb doesn't light up.

none.text: With nothing connecting the battery to the bulb, the circuit stays open. Without a closed path, current can't flow.

light.title: Light Lab
light.question: Pick two different colored lights and guess what color comes out of the mix!
light.guessLabel: What color do you think will appear?

red-green.text: Red light + green light = yellow light! Mixing LIGHT colors is different from mixing paint — light adds up and gets brighter.

red-blue.text: Red light + blue light = magenta! Each colored light carries part of the sun's white light.

green-blue.text: Green light + blue light = cyan! Combine all three (red, green, and blue) and you get white light.

sound.title: Sound Lab
sound.question: Move the distance and hear how the sound changes!

0.text: Close to the source, the sound arrives loud and clear.

1.text: At a medium distance, the sound already arrives quieter.

2.text: Very far away, the sound is barely heard — it loses strength as it travels through the air.

magnetism.title: Magnet Lab
magnetism.question: Bring the magnet close to different objects and find out which ones get attracted!
magnetism.predictQuestion: Do you think the magnet will attract this object?

nail.text: The nail is made of iron — magnets attract iron and steel, so it sticks to the magnet!

spoon.text: Plastic isn't attracted by magnets. The spoon stays put.

wood.text: Wood isn't attracted by magnets. The block doesn't move.

can.text: Aluminum usually isn't attracted by ordinary magnets. The can stays put.

buoyancy.title: Float or Sink?
buoyancy.question: Pick an object and find out if it floats or sinks in water!
buoyancy.predictQuestion: Do you think this object will float?

duck.text: The rubber duck is hollow and full of air — it floats easily on the surface!

rock.text: The rock is dense and heavy for its size — it sinks straight to the bottom.

spoon.text: Metal is dense — the spoon sinks quickly.

wood.text: Wood is less dense than water — it floats on the surface!
